name: nanutech-frontend-workspace
description: Monorepo para el sistema de gestión de flota NANU TECH

scripts.build:remotes: npm run build -w apps/mfe-flota && npm run build -w apps/mfe-contratos && npm run build -w apps/mfe-dashboard
scripts.preview:remotes: concurrently -c "magenta,yellow,green" "npm run preview -w apps/mfe-flota" "npm run preview -w apps/mfe-contratos" "npm run preview -w apps/mfe-dashboard"
scripts.start:ecosystem: npm run build:remotes && concurrently -c "cyan,gray" "npm run preview:remotes" "npm run dev:shell"
